title: review step answer
description: A verdict, and every finding behind it, each carrying the grade that decides what it costs. Critical, Major and Minor send the work back and are fixed in this change; a Nit is dropped. The verdict is read off the grades, never typed beside them: SHIP with a Critical, Major or Minor, and BLOCKED with none, are both refused.

skills.description: Every Superpowers skill invoked in this step. The driver cross-checks this against the Skill calls in the run log, so a claim here the log does not show is a failed step.

round.description: Which review round this is. The driver allows two; a blocking finding left after that keeps the change from merging.

findings.description: Everything this review raised, at every grade. One list, because the grade already says what each one costs — a second list saying the same thing is a second place for the two to disagree.

grade.description: critical: wrong data, a security hole, lost work, something published unapproved. major: a person is misled or stuck — an untrue screen, a dead control, a failure shown as success. minor: polish — spacing, wording, a small visual slip. nit: taste.

reason.description: One line, in a user's words, saying why this grade. A Critical or a Major names who is harmed and how; a grade with no harm behind it is a Minor wearing a blocker's label.

question.description: Why this step cannot finish. Answerable in a line: a yes/no or a pick.

questionFor.description: Who answers the question. `owner`: pixels, a picture, a product or commercial call, or the data model. `pm`: the ticket's shape — which repo, how it splits, the order, the wording of its acceptance. Unsure is `owner`; the driver treats anything but `pm` as the owner's.
